title: Catalyst Crew Technologies Corp. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-13
summary: Catalyst Crew Technologies Corp., a Nevada-registered micro-cap company based in Venezuela, filed an 8-K disclosing the acquisition of a Venezuelan subsidiary and reassignment of AI healthcare-related intellectual property (CardioAI, PulmoAI, NeuroAI) as part of an internal reorganization.
key_points: The company acquired assets including proprietary software, ML models, and datasets for an AI-enabled healthcare analytics platform via an Asset Purchase Agreement dated February 17, 2026.
On March 23, 2026, the company acquired 100% of Inversiones Long 33, C.A., a Venezuelan subsidiary, via a Share Assignment Agreement.
On April 7, 2026, intellectual property rights (CardioAI, PulmoAI, NeuroAI) were assigned to the subsidiary as an internal reorganization step with no additional consideration.
The company is an emerging growth company and its securities are not listed on a national exchange.
The company issued press releases on five dates in March-April 2026 announcing the operating structure and product introductions.
